mapper.insert: INSERT INTO phone_verifications ( user_id, phone_number, code_hash, status, attempt_count, expires_at, resend_available_at, verified_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{phoneNumber}, #{codeHash}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{expiresAt}, #{resendAvailableAt}, #{verifiedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, phone_number, code_hash, status, attempt_count, expires_at, resend_available_at, verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM phone_verifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, phone_number, code_hash, status, attempt_count, expires_at, resend_available_at, verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM phone_verifications WHERE phone_number = #{phoneNumber} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, phone_number, code_hash, status, attempt_count, expires_at, resend_available_at, verified_at, created_at, updated_at FROM phone_verifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND phone_number = #{phoneNumber} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
